glosses: reach, range, scope (maximum distance something can reach)

examples.en: It was out of his reach.

examples.text: Este es el alcance de mi talento.
examples.en: This is the extent of my ability.

examples.text: Pon esta medicina fuera del alcance de los niños.
examples.en: Put this medicine where children can't get it.

examples.text: Tal lujo está más allá de mi alcance.
examples.en: Such luxury is beyond my reach.

examples.text: Este medicamento no se debe dejar al alcance de los niños.
examples.en: This medicine must not be placed within the reach of children.
